name: Jane Austen
q: Vanity and pride are different things
Better no sense than misused sense
For true friends, nothing is too much
We each have our own best guide within
I have a stubbornness that fears no one
Know your own happiness; only patience is needed
I alone decide my own happiness
Till this moment, I never knew myself
I could have forgiven his pride
A rich single man must want a wife
There is no enjoyment like reading
Loving longest, when hope is gone
Happiness in marriage is entirely a matter of chance
One half cannot know the other's joys
If I loved you less, I might be able to talk about it more
My affections and wishes are unchanged
